title: Linije 1, 8, 17 – Privremena izmena trase u Ulici Jovana Subotića

sections.text: U skladu sa rešenjem Gradske uprave za saobraćaj i puteve, zbog radova u Ulici Jovana Subotića od 24. 8. do 28. 8. 2026. godine privremeno će biti izmenjene trase autobuskih linija broj 1, 8  i 17.

text_translations.en: In accordance with the decision of the City Administration for Traffic and Roads, due to works in Jovana Subotić Street from August 24 to August 28, 2026, the routes of bus lines 1, 8 and 17 will be temporarily changed.

sections.text: LINIJA 1

text_translations.en: LINE 1

sections.text: Na raskrsnici Kisačka/Bulevar kralja Petra prvog autobusi će skretati desno na Bulevar kralja Petra prvog, levo u Ulicu braće Jovandić, saobraćati Ulicom vojvode Bojovića, skretati desno u Ulicu Jovana Subotića i dalje će nastavljati redovnom trasom.

text_translations.en: At the intersection of Kisačka/Bulevar Kralja Petar I, buses will turn right onto Bulevar Kralja Petar I, left into Ulica Brače Jovandić, drive through Ulica Vojvoda Bojovića, turn right into Ulica Jovana Subotić and continue on the regular route.

sections.text: Na izmenjenom delu trase koristiće se stajalište  BULEVAR KRALJA PETRA PRVOG- KISAČKA.

text_translations.en: On the changed part of the route, the stop KRALJA PETRA PRVOG - KISAČKA will be used.

sections.text: Na raskrsnici Vojvode Bojovića/Jovana Subotića autobusi će skretati levo u Ulicu vojvode Bojovića, saobraćati Ulicom braće Jovandić, skretati desno na Bulevar kralja Petra prvog i saobraćati do Kisačke ulice gde će skretati levo i nastavljati redovnom trasom.

text_translations.en: At the intersection of Vojvoda Bojović/Jovan Subotić, buses will turn left into Vojvoda Bojovića Street, drive through Brače Jovandić Street, turn right onto Kralja Petar 1 Boulevard and drive to Kisačka Street, where they will turn left and continue along the regular route.

sections.text: Na izmenjenom delu trase koristiće se stajalište  VOJVODE BOJOVIĆA -SOCIJALNO.

text_translations.en: On the changed part of the route, the stop VOJVODE BOJOVĆ - SOCIJALNO will be used.

sections.text: LINIJA 8

text_translations.en: LINE 8

sections.text: Na raskrsnici Bulevar oslobođenja/Bulevar kralja Petra prvog autobusi će skretati desno na Bulevar oslobođenja, levo u Jevrejsku ulicu, desno na Bulevar Mihajla Pupina, gde će nastavljati redovnom trasom.

text_translations.en: At the intersection of Boulevard of Liberation/Bulevar of King Peter the First, buses will turn right onto Boulevard of Liberation, left into Jevrejska Street, right onto Boulevard of Mihajla Pupin, where they will continue on their regular route.

sections.text: Na izmenjenom delu trase koristiće se stajalište  BULEVAR OSLOBOĐENJA - BULEVAR KRALJA PETRA PRVOG (Lutrija).

text_translations.en: On the changed part of the route, the stop BULEVAR OSLOBOĖENJA - BULEVAR KRALJA PETRA PRVOG (Lottery) will be used.

sections.text: Na raskrsnici Bulevar Mihajla Pupina/Jevrejska ulica autobusi će skretati levo u Jevrejsku ulicu, desno na Bulevar oslobođenja, levo na Bulevar kralja Petra prvog i nastavljati redovnom trasom.

text_translations.en: At the intersection of Bulevar Mihajla Pupina/Jevrejska ulica, buses will turn left onto Jevrejska ulica, right onto Bulevar oslobodenja, left onto Bulevar Kralja Petar the First and continue along the regular route.

sections.text: Na izmenjenom delu trase koristiće se stajalište  BULEVAR OSLOBOĐENJA – JEVREJSKA (Futoška pijaca).

text_translations.en: On the changed part of the route, the stop BULEVAR OSLOBOĖENJA - JEVREJSKA (Futoška pijaca) will be used.

sections.text: LINIJA 17

text_translations.en: LINE 17

sections.text: Na raskrsnici Kisačka/Bulevar kralja Petra prvog autobusi će skretati desno na Bulevar kralja Petra prvog, levo u Ulicu braće Jovandić, saobraćati Ulicom vojvode Bojovića, skretati desno u Ulicu Jovana Subotića i nastavljati redovnom trasom.

text_translations.en: At the Kisačka/King Petar I Boulevard intersection, buses will turn right onto Kralja Petar I Boulevard, left into Ulica Brače Jovandić, drive through Ulica Vojvoda Bojovića, turn right into Ulica Jovana Subotić and continue along the regular route.

sections.text: Na izmenjenom delu trase koristiće se stajalište  BULEVAR KRALJA PETRA PRVOG- KISAČKA.

text_translations.en: On the changed part of the route, the stop KRALJA PETRA PRVOG - KISAČKA will be used.

sections.text: Redovna trasa.

text_translations.en: Regular route.

title_translations.en: Lines 1, 8, 17 – Temporary change of route in Jovana Subotić Street

title: Linija 54 – Privremena izmena trase u Futogu

sections.text: U skladu sa rešenjem Gradske uprave za saobraćaj i puteve, u periodu od 20. avgusta do 4. septembra 2026. godine određuje se privremena izmena trase autobuske linije broj 54.

text_translations.en: In accordance with the decision of the City Administration for Traffic and Roads, in the period from August 20 to September 4, 2026, a temporary change of the route of bus line number 54 is determined.

sections.text: Do završetka radova na popravci i rekonstrukciji kolovoza, autobusi će umesto Grmečkom ulicom u oba smera saobraćati ŽELEZNIČKOM ULICOM.

text_translations.en: Until the completion of the roadway repair and reconstruction works, instead of Grmečka Street, buses will travel in both directions on ŽELEZNIČKA STREET.

sections.text: Na izmenjenom delu trase koristiće se stajališta „Rade Kondića – NIS benzinska pumpa“ i „Železnička – Dom za stara lica“ (smer iz Novog Sada), a u povratku stajališta „Železnička – Dom za stara lica“ i „Železnička – Njegoševa“.

text_translations.en: On the modified part of the route, the stops "Rade Kondića - NIS gas station" and "Zeleznička - Dom za stara lica" (direction from Novi Sad) will be used, and on the way back the stops "Zeleznička - Dom za stara lica" and "Zeleznička - Njegoševa" will be used.

title_translations.en: Line 54 – Temporary route change in Futog

title: Linije 6, 11B – Povratak na redovne trase na Beogradskom keju

sections.text: U skladu sa obaveštenjem izvođača radova na rekonstrukciji poveznog voda na Beogradskom keju, obaveštavamo putnike da će se 16. 8. 2026. godine steći uslovi za ukidanje privremene izmene trasa linija 6 i 11B. Autobusi će se vratiti na redovnu trasu odmah nakon puštanja saobraćajnica u redovan saobraćaj.

text_translations.en: In accordance with the notification of the contractor for the reconstruction of the connecting line on the Belgrade Quay, we inform passengers that on August 16, 2026, the conditions will be met for the cancellation of the temporary changes to the routes of lines 6 and 11B. The buses will return to the regular route immediately after the roads are opened to regular traffic.

title_translations.en: Lines 6, 11B – Return to regular routes on Belgrade Quay

title: Linija 24 - Privremena izmena trase u Kovilju

sections.text: Obaveštavamo putnike da će od 13. 8. do 28. 8. 2026. godine privremeno biti izmenjena trasa autobuske linije broj 24. U skladu sa rešenjem Gradske uprave za saobraćaj i puteve, do izmene će doći zbog rekonstrukcije Ulice Branka Bajića, na delu od Ulice Petra Drapšina i Ulice Laze Kostića do Ulice kralja Petra prvog u Kovilju.

text_translations.en: We inform passengers that from August 13 to August 28, 2026, the route of bus line number 24 will be temporarily changed. In accordance with the decision of the City Administration for Traffic and Roads, the change will occur due to the reconstruction of Branko Bajić Street, on the part from Petra Drapšin Street and Laza Kostić Street to Kralja Petra prvič Street in Kovilje.

sections.text: Na raskrsnici ulica Branka Bajića i Petra Drapšina autobusi će skretati desno u Ulicu Petra Drapšina, saobraćati pravo do Kralja Petra prvog, levo ulicom Kralja Petra prvog do Ulice Laze Kostića i desno nastavljati redovnom trasom.

text_translations.en: At the intersection of Branko Bajića and Petra Drapšina streets, the buses will turn right into Petra Drapšina Street, drive straight to Kralja Petra the first, left along Kralja Petra the first to Laza Kostić Street and continue on the right on the regular route.

sections.text: Na raskrsnici ulica Laze Kostića i Kralja Petra prvog autobusi će saobraćati levo Ulicom kralja Petra prvog do Ulice Petra Drapšina, skretati desno u Ulicu Petra Drapšina, nastavljati pravo do Ulice Branka Bajića, levo Ulicom Branka Bajića i dalje redovnom trasom.

text_translations.en: At the intersection of Laza Kostića and Kralja Petra 1st streets, buses will drive left along Kralja Petra 1st Street to Petra Drapšina Street, turn right into Petra Drapšina Street, continue straight to Branka Bajić Street, left along Branka Bajić Street and continue along the regular route.

title_translations.en: Line 24 - Temporary route change in Kovilje

title: Linija 14 – Privremeno ukidanje stajališta Veternik-Kralja Petra prvog

sections.text: U skladu sa rešenjem Gradske uprave za saobraćaj i puteve,  od 11. 8. do 25. 8. 2026. godine privremeno se ukida autobusko stajalište Veternik-Kralja Petra prvog 97 (ispred auto salona „KIA“), smer sa Sajlova. Navedeno stajalište neće biti u funkciji zbog izvođenja građevinskih radova.

text_translations.en: In accordance with the decision of the City Administration for Traffic and Roads, from August 11 to August 25, 2026, the Veternik-Kralja Petra first bus stop at 97 (in front of the "KIA" car showroom), direction from Sajlov, will be temporarily closed. The said stop will not be in operation due to construction works.

title_translations.en: Line 14 - Temporary cancellation of the Veternik-Kralja Petar I stop

sections.text: Obaveštavamo korisnike usluge prevoza na liniji 16 da je zbog usklađivanja sa potrebama građana polazak u 15:10 časova u aktuelnom redu vožnje pomeren na 16:10 časova.

text_translations.en: We inform the users of the transportation service on line 16 that, due to compliance with the needs of citizens, the departure at 3:10 p.m. in the current timetable has been moved to 4:10 p.m.
